feedback: The confession follows the most important pre-vote contradiction: Paige relocates an interview whose retained opening objectively places her beside the prepared glass at the gala. Her source-protection explanation now reads as a plausible shield for a self-protective edit. Taking poison at the closed preview supplies the exact handling detail I had inferred but could not independently trace; it does not change which lie identified her. The admission that her source never asked for this gives the motive an effective moral reversal without excusing the murder. Barb and Chip's responses keep their separate misconduct consequential. The ending feels earned, although the exact poison retrieval would be more satisfying with one modest earlier proximity clue.
